name: p4-memory
description: p4-memory — the built-in per-project memory (the base class the vlds override wraps) is stored in the p4 repo, <project>/.claude/p4/memory/, and nowhere else. At every session start every AppData memory source under ~/.claude/projects/<project-slug>/ — the memory/ directory, a junction or symlink to p4 an earlier version left (removed as a link, its target untouched), and every memory.pre-p4-<time> directory — is merged into .claude/p4/memory/ (identical → dropped; a live file absent in p4 → moved in; any other → kept at .conflicts/<source>/<path> for the owner's merge, a p4 file never overwritten) and then deleted, leaving one file in AppData: a pointer MEMORY.md telling the session that its memory lives in .claude/p4/memory/ and must be read and written there; the start prints the p4 MEMORY.md, since the harness loaded only the pointer. A Write or Edit into AppData is moved into p4 at once by a PostToolUse hook (index lines added to the pointer appended to the p4 MEMORY.md, the pointer restored) and the session told where it went; a deletion the harness blocks is retried and swept at the turn's close. The harness's transcripts and per-session directories beside it are never touched. Depends on vlds, which creates and initializes the p4 repo.
